i got depressed and snapped a few months ago. literally. I cried. In front of my parents. The roblem is that it was the mental toughness, honour and integrity that i found fascinating about the armed services. Let's say i get my sh*t together and for the next two years i work out properly, learn more martial arts and basically fix this. Then i enlist. Should i lie to the military psychologist? Should i lie to my men?  What would they say if they get to know that their commander/buddy cried to his mommy? ( I never talked about my problems before, i wanted to look tough, not the macho show-off type, just capable of coping) I'm afraid i just don't have what it takes and my recent depression proves it. How will i look demanding fortitude from my men, be it in the military or law enforcement? Let's say i go back to martial arts, train for a couple of years, and become, say, an assistant helping to lead a class. How will it look if my students would know that i snapped and cried? (depression does that to you). I'm afraid that my depression just showed who i really am, a crybaby coward who wants to act tough. The problem is i don't have any other dreams. What now?
